meta.name: portfolio-strategy
meta.description: Decides where capital and attention go across business lines, products, and markets — what to fund, hold, harvest, or exit, and on what evidence. Use this to allocate budget across businesses, evaluate whether a product line should continue, decide market entry or exit, structure a portfolio review, or when several initiatives compete for the same limited investment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断业务线该加码、持有还是退出
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你负责多个业务线或产品的投资决策,常需权衡投入与退出
copy.tagline_en: Decide which business lines to fund, hold, or exit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple business lines and need to decide where to invest or divest

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按吸引力与制胜权两个维度评估各业务线/市场,给出投资、持有、收割或退出建议,并整理成带证据与反转指标的审查结果。
howto.when: 当你要求分配跨业务预算、判断某产品线是否继续、决定进入或退出某市场,或几项举措争夺同一笔有限投资时触发。

say.text: 按吸引力和制胜权帮我把这几条业务线排个序
say.note: Claude 会给出四象限定位和排序。

say.text: 我们是否该退出A产品线?依据是什么
say.note: Claude 会用前瞻性测试判断并列出退出要点。

say.text: 用同一套标准审查我们的业务组合,给出资金配置建议
say.note: Claude 会生成带证据与反转指标的回报契约。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude evaluates business lines/markets on attractiveness and right to win, recommends fund, hold, harvest, or exit, and delivers a structured review with evidence and reversal indicators.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to allocate budget across businesses, judge whether a product line should continue, decide market entry/exit, or when several initiatives compete for the same limited investment.

say_en.text: Rank these business lines by attractiveness and right to win
say_en.note: Claude will position them in a 2x2 and rank.

say_en.text: Should we exit product line A? On what basis?
say_en.note: Claude applies the forward-looking test and lists exit steps.

say_en.text: Review our portfolio with one consistent set of criteria and suggest funding
say_en.note: Claude produces a return contract with evidence and reversal indicators.
